summary: Sprint V1.0 Follow-up 2 verification (both backend + frontend). All 4 sprint items pass: (1) Customers 'All' unified view — chip present as DEFAULT (order: All, Subscribers, Loyalty, Inquiries, Messages), all-customers-section + all-customers-search testids render, unified list shows 70 customers (40 email + 30 loyalty), search filter works. (2) Home 'Most shared flyers' widget — home-top-shared-flyers visible after seeding a share via backend, renders '1 share total' + item name + last theme correctly. (3) Photo-to-Flyer new buttons — photo-flyer-share-flyer AND photo-flyer-post-to-instagram testids verified in PhotoToFlyer.jsx source (lines 1483, 1490). (4) Snapshot suite — 22/22 passing (byte-identical SHA-256 hashes match pre-refactor). Backend endpoints: POST /api/analytics/flyer-share returns {ok:true,tracked:true}; GET /api/analytics/flyer-shares returns testitem with share_count>=1; missing item_key returns {ok:true,tracked:false} (correct no-op behavior). All 5 public endpoints (/api/content, /api/menu, /api/homepage/layout, /api/specials?active_only=true, /api/html-template/featured) return 200. Public homepage loads with 0 console errors; admin login works with rotated password. Zero console errors during full dashboard flow.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/analytics.py POST /api/analytics/flyer-share doesn't use a Pydantic model — accepts raw body dict. Minor: consider a FlyerShareIn Pydantic model to align with rest of codebase and get automatic validation/OpenAPI schema.
The _FlyerShareTracker empty class (analytics.py L255-257) is dead code — 'namespace holder' comment but no methods attached; endpoints are module-level. Safe to delete.
PhotoToFlyer.jsx is now ~1900 LOC (still exceeds 700 guideline) — router-split done for backend todays_pick.py; a similar split for PhotoToFlyer step-components remains a good follow-up.
